cbomkit.name: CBOMkit-action
cbomkit.description: CBOM generation from source code (Java, Python, Go, C#) via the Sonar Cryptography plugin, packaged as the cbomkit-action container.  Not available as a local install: the jar depends on packages hosted on GitHub Packages, so the published image is the reproducible artefact.
